notablePrerequisites:
For infinite mana, {3}{R}{R} is required, and your opponents must have at least 3 artifacts and/or enchantments.
For infinite creature tokens and mana, {5}{R}{R} is required, and your opponents must have at least 4 artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist for {1}{R}.
If you want infinite creature tokens, skip to step 8; otherwise, continue to step 3.
Dockside Extortionist ETBs, putting its ETB trigger onto the stack.
Tap Lithoform Engine, copying the ETB and triggering Kurkesh.
Pay {R} for the Kurkesh, copying the ETB an additional time.
Resolve both copied ETBs, generating at least 6 treasures.
Continue from step 11.
While Dockside Extortionist is still on the stack, tap Lithoform Engine for {4} to copy Dockside Extortionist, triggering Kurkesh.
Pay {R} for the Kurkesh trigger, copying Dockside Extortionist an additional time.
Resolve both Dockside Extortionist copies, creating at least 8 treasure tokens.
Tap Voltaic Key for 1 treasure token, untapping Lithoform Engine and triggering Kurkesh.
Spend 1 treasure token to pay for the trigger, copying the untap ability targeting Voltaic Key.
Repeat for infinite treasure tokens, and creature tokens if applicable.
